0x001264.en: 「I'll walk the path I believe in...!」

0x00129B.en: 「Sorry, Masaki... but I'll walk/　the path I believe in to the very/　end... that's all I can do!」

0x001328.en: 「It all ends with this one battle.../　No matter which of us wins.../　that's the kind of fight this is!」

0x0013AC.en: 「All of it falls on me alone!/　This is how I take responsibility/　for everyone who died in this war!」

0x001439.en: 「Tytti, I'm sorry for keeping you in the dark.../　But you'd have opposed me if I'd told you./　I... knew that all along.」

0x0014DB.en: 「Sorry, Tytti./　Let's settle this quickly.../　I... don't have much... time...」

0x001553.en: 「I'm grateful to you, Tytti./　Even as an enemy now, that hasn't changed./　So I'll give it everything!」

0x0015E6.en: 「Xenia... you'll turn on me too...?/　Heh... truly my sister.../　Good... that's how it should be.」

0x001679.en: 「Xenia, be sure to eject./　Succession rights or not, you're still royalty./　You don't get to throw your life away.」

0x001709.en: 「Oh, right, Xenia./　Odd timing, but the carrier's build is on track./　Put it to good use.」

0x001796.en: 「Presia.../　You still have your whole future ahead of you.../　Make sure you eject.」

0x001814.en: 「Heh... you're a full pilot now, Presia./　As a Machina master, you're legally an adult.../　I won't hold back.」

0x0018AD.en: 「Zeoruot's daughter, no doubt about it./　A fine stance.../　You'll surely make a great warrior.」

0x001934.en: 「Gennacy,/　you were a quiet but dependable pilot.../　Still are, in fact. Don't throw your life away.」

0x0019CA.en: 「Gennacy... that's fine./　Give Masaki and the others/　your full support...」

0x001A4B.en: 「I doubt you'd die from something like this.../　But there's always a chance./　Don't neglect your ejection gear.」

0x001AD8.en: 「Zashford... if you're here,/　then you fought my father.../　I see... then you've steeled yourself for this.」

0x001B80.en: 「I put you through a lot of pain,/　Zashford... but/　it all ends here... I won't hold back!」

0x001C1C.en: 「So you pilot Galguard now.../　Then take the code of a Machina master/　and carve it deep into your heart!」

0x001CAF.en: 「Yang Long.../　You were a Machinery God pilot too, of course.../　Good... that's just fine.」

0x001D30.en: 「My duty as a Machinery God pilot, is it.../　Yes.../　Perhaps it was all for this very day...」

0x001DBD.en: 「Heh.../　To see the Machinery Gods gathered/　in a form like this...」

0x001E2F.en: 「Lune,/　you could have the same rights and duties as a/　Machinery God pilot... you've got what it takes.」

0x001EB3.en: 「Mio... you too are a Machinery God pilot./　Ricardo would have done the very same...」

0x001F36.en: 「Don't hesitate, Mio./　Just follow the voice of your heart.../　That's what a Machinery God pilot is.」

0x001FBD.en: 「Good eyes, Mio./　Ricardo found a fine successor.../　A worthy opponent for me!」

0x00203E.en: 「People of the surface,/　fight by your convictions. I won't hold back either!」

0x002097.en: 「Heh... so you side with Masaki too.」

0x0020D4.en: 「Come to think of it, I never properly apologized./　I'm sorry for dragging you surface people in./　My apologies.」

0x002170.en: 「I owe you a debt.../　but even so, I can't back down now!」

0x002374.en: 「Guh!!/　Even for Duraxil,/　this damage is...」

0x0023DA.en: 「Cybuster.../　To think you'd be this much of a threat as an enemy... huh.」

0x002436.en: 「Guh!/　N-not bad, Tytti.../　That's just fine...」

0x00249C.en: 「N-no way.../　Never once dreamed/　Xenia would corner me...」

0x002511.en: 「Guh!!/　To pull this off with Diablo.../　Presia, you've become a fine pilot...」

0x00258F.en: 「D-damn.../　Gennacy, so you were there.../　I overlooked you.」

0x0025F8.en: 「Ngh!!/　Zashford.../　you've let go of your doubts... well done.」

0x002661.en: 「Gaaah!/　W-what tremendous power.../　So this is Granveil's true worth...」

0x002748.en: 「Guh!!/　You've already mastered Zamzeed this well.../　Impressive...」

0x0027BA.en: 「Gah...!/　Princess Shine... even back home,/　don't forget what this battle meant...!」

0x00283B.en: 「Guh...!/　Raideus... your voice, your words,/　I've taken them to heart...!」

0x00290F.en: 「A fine attack.../　but Duraxil won't fall to just that!」

0x002971.en: 「Impressive... truly Cybuster./　You're the biggest obstacle here, after all...」

0x0029D3.en: 「Good attack, Tytti./　Your hesitation is fading.」

0x002A23.en: 「Oho... to do this much with Norse./　I've reassessed you, Xenia.」

0x002A7C.en: 「Hmm.../　No surprise you're the Sword Emperor's daughter-growing fast,/　Presia.」

0x002AD9.en: 「Not bad, Gennacy./　A quiet but fine attack, just like you.」

0x002B32.en: 「Mm.../　My apologies, Zashford./　I underestimated your power a little.」

0x002BA1.en: 「Yes, this is Granveil's power./　It's no fun otherwise.」

0x002C09.en: 「Oho... just as I thought./　Power rivaling a Machinery God.../　Use it well, Lune.」

0x002C87.en: 「Mm... I see,/　you're quite special in many ways, Mio.」

0x002CD7.en: 「A brave princess.../　Your people must adore you back home.」

0x002D2A.en: 「Yes... no need to hold back, Raideus.」

0x002DC3.en: 「Did you really think/　that could stop me?」

0x002E72.en: 「It's useless.../　Nothing can stop/　this Duraxil...」

0x002EDB.en: 「Do you understand, Masaki.../　the power of this Duraxil,/　surpassing even Cybuster...」

0x002F59.en: 「You're hesitating, Tytti.../　Hesitation on the battlefield costs lives!/　Cast it aside!」

0x002FD1.en: 「Stop now, Xenia./　Norse can't stand against me.」

0x00301B.en: 「You've got talent.../　but you're far from your father yet, Presia!」

0x0030D0.en: 「Galguard is a fine machine.../　but it's wasted on you.」

0x00311D.en: 「Behold, Yang Long./　Even with Granveil's power,/　this is all you can do against Duraxil!」

0x003203.en: 「Raideus.../　you can't stop me with something like that.」

0x003259.en: 「This Duraxil, built with surface tech,/　outclasses even your machines.../　You cannot stop it!」

0x003400.en: 「Presia... it's still too soon for you.」

0x003511.en: 「Fast, Valsione./ But your aim is sloppy!」

0x003769.en: 「Here I go... for the fate of La Gias!」
